title.zh: Lloyds与Visa完成首笔USDC稳定币结算试点
title.en: Lloyds and Visa Complete First USDC Stablecoin Settlement Pilot

current_state.zh: Lloyds Banking Group completed its first stablecoin settlement pilot with Visa, using USDC purchased through regulated exchange Archax to settle $750,000 of payment obligations, with funds reaching Visa in under an hour including over a weekend.
current_state.en: Lloyds Banking Group completed its first stablecoin settlement pilot with Visa, using USDC purchased through regulated exchange Archax to settle $750,000 of payment obligations, with funds reaching Visa in under an hour including over a weekend.

updates.title_zh: Lloyds and Visa Settle $750,000 in USDC in Cross-Border Pilot
updates.title_en: Lloyds and Visa Settle $750,000 in USDC in Cross-Border Pilot
updates.what_changed_zh: Lloyds and Visa completed a seven-day cross-border pilot settling $750,000 in USDC from Jersey to the US in under an hour, including over a weekend, with Lloyds using Canton and Visa a separate blockchain.
